faq.title: The questions we get.
faq.subtitle: If yours isn't here, drop us a line at contact@meshvise.com. Reply within one business day.

compatible_plc.q: Compatible with my Schneider M340 / Siemens S7-1500 / other PLC?
compatible_plc.a_html: If your PLC speaks Modbus TCP, OPC-UA or BACnet/IP, yes. For Modbus RTU over serial, plan a TCP gateway. See the Capabilities section.

data_format.q: What format is the data stored in?
data_format.a_html: Configuration: standard PostgreSQL tables. History: TimescaleDB table point_history(ts, point_id, value, quality), automatically partitioned by day for fast queries over multi-year ranges. Everything queryable in plain SQL, no proprietary dialect.

powerbi.q: How do I connect Power BI?
powerbi.a_html: Power BI Desktop > Get Data > PostgreSQL. You enter your Meshvise server's IP, a read-only user, and you see the tables. Native connection, exactly like any standard PostgreSQL database.

self_host.a_html: Self-hosted. Your data never leaves your network. The online demo runs on a public environment but it's a demo, not a production offer.

sovereignty_data.q: Does my data stay in France?
sovereignty_data.a_html: Yes, by design. Meshvise is self-hosted: your instance runs on the infrastructure you choose, in France if that's what you pick. We do not store any customer data on our infrastructure. No telemetry leaves your network, no phone-home, no foreign cloud dependency. Air-gap compatible for sites disconnected from the internet.

gdpr_compliance.a_html: Yes. Meshvise is GDPR compliant by design: no personal data leaves your instance by default. For the Standard plan we provide a DPA (Data Processing Agreement) with the contract. Data and support under French law, jurisdiction in Paris.

minimum_hardware.a_html: 2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 20 GB disk are enough for ~500 points with 30 days of history. Runs on an industrial mini-PC, a Raspberry Pi 4 or a €5/month VPS.

security.a_html: JWT auth (UI) or API key (integrations). Postgres and Redis bind to localhost, never exposed. Behind a reverse-proxy (Caddy, Nginx, Cloudflare Tunnel) you get automatic TLS.

code_audit.q: Can I audit the source code?
code_audit.a_html: On request for Standard customers, read access to the source code under NDA. This option exists for specific compliance needs: security audits, regulatory validation, due diligence. Outside an NDA, the code remains closed under our proprietary licence. Contact: contact@meshvise.com.

safety_sil.q: Can I run functional safety (SIL) on it?
safety_sil.a_html: No, and never will. Meshvise supervises and historises. Your safety interlocks must stay in your certified PLC.

company_disappears.q: What if you shut down tomorrow?
company_disappears.a_html: Fair question, and the main reason Meshvise stores everything in standard SQL. Concretely: your postgres runs on your server. Your Power BI dashboards keep working. For acquisition, you replace Meshvise with any other platform speaking Modbus / OPC-UA / BACnet.

multi_site.a_html: Today: multi-project on a single instance, ideal for multi-building setups within one group. Distant multi-site with edge gateways and a consolidating central: Q4 2026 roadmap.

wiresheet_status.q: What exactly does the wiresheet do?
wiresheet_status.a_html: A visual grid where you compose your site logic: math, boolean logic, comparison, timer, schedule, latch, ramp, PID, alarm. Drag-and-drop, mouse-driven connections, block palette on the left. Each graph is versioned as JSON, one-click revert, full audit trail. For automated integrations (CI, CMMS), everything is also drivable via the REST API.

support.a_html: Discovery plan: public documentation + best-effort email to contact@meshvise.com. Standard plan: email with a 1-business-day response SLA (French public holidays excluded), video calls on request, direct access to the lead developer.

support_language.a_html: Yes. Email support at contact@meshvise.com is handled by a French team, with a 1-business-day SLA for Standard customers. Public documentation is available in French and English. Tickets in English are handled by the same team.

trial.q: How long do I need to seriously try it?
trial.a_html: Three doors depending on your need. The online demo works as an instant POC (60 seconds of clicking around). The 7-day trial gives you the full app on your infra, with your PLCs, to validate in real conditions. Beyond that, you switch to a yearly Standard licence (€990).

demo_vs_trial.q: What's the difference between the online demo and the 7-day trial?
demo_vs_trial.a_html: The online demo is public, runs on our server with simulated industrial-site data. You click around, see the UI, close the tab. No sign-up, nothing to install. Best for a first look. The 7-day trial, on the other hand, gives you the full app on your own infrastructure. You fill a form, receive a license.jwt and a docker-compose.yml by email, run docker compose up -d on your server, wire up your real PLCs. That's the serious evaluation before purchase.

trial_what_happens.a_html: You fill the form on /en/trial/. You immediately receive an email with your license.jwt, a ready-to-use docker-compose.yml, and the install command. You run docker compose up -d on your server, wire up your PLCs, explore. No credit card, no auto-renewal, no extra account on top.

trial_end.q: What happens to my install when the 7 days are up?
trial_end.a_html: The app switches to read-only. You keep access to your historised data, you can export your configuration and historian. Writes (adding a point, editing an alarm, deploying a revision) are blocked until you activate a production licence. Nothing is deleted, nothing is volatile. To extend, write to contact@meshvise.com.

final_cta.subtitle: Explore the live demo in 60 seconds. Or install Meshvise on your own infra for 7 days, with your real PLCs. No credit card, no commitment.

mission.heading: The mission
mission.body_html: Meshvise started from a simple observation: industrial supervision is too expensive, too closed, too dependent on foreign vendors. We are building a French alternative, open on SQL data, with predictable pricing and compliance by design. All points included in the Standard licence, no foreign cloud: one price at renewal, set once and for all.

values.heading: Values
values.v1_html: Sovereignty. Your data on your server, your keys on your desk. No telemetry, no phone-home.
values.v2_html: Transparency. Public roadmap, posted pricing, readable French-language EULA. What is not shipped is announced as such.
values.v3_html: Pragmatism. We ship what works today. We announce what's coming with a date. We don't promise a universal SCADA.
